brent.name: Brent Crude

latest_quote.note: Yahoo Finance labels BZ=F as a delayed quote. The source provides 1-minute bars; GitHub Actions checks them every 5 minutes, which is GitHub's shortest scheduled interval.

brent.history_scope: Maximum daily history available from Yahoo Finance BZ=F

jet_fuel.name: Singapore Jet Kerosene
jet_fuel.source: Public Singapore jet archive + U.S. EIA legacy series + ANA/JAL official period averages
jet_fuel.price_field: Indicative / historical FOB Singapore jet kerosene reference
jet_fuel.note: Long history contains frequency/source breaks. Daily EIA/current data are preserved. The 2010-2026 gap is filled where possible with official ANA and JAL Singapore kerosene period averages; no synthetic interpolation is used.

history_segments.source: U.S. EIA legacy Singapore Kerosene-Type Jet Fuel Spot Price FOB
history_segments.note: Legacy historical benchmark; methodology/source differs from the current public indicative archive.
Current public indicative FOB Singapore mid; not a licensed Platts/CME settlement feed.

ana_history_backfill.method: Monthly average Singapore kerosene prices explicitly disclosed in ANA Cargo fuel-surcharge notices
ana_history_backfill.frequency: Monthly observations where an ANA notice is publicly archived
ana_history_backfill.caveat: Official monthly period averages, not reconstructed daily Platts assessments. Existing EIA/current daily observations are never overwritten.
